description: Canonical chain plus any competing orphan blocks around a height. 'to' is the highest height in the window (defaults to the current tip); lower it to browse older history down to the genesis block. limit 10..500.

limit.description: Number of heights in the window, 10 to 500. Example: 100
limit.title: Limit

to.description: Highest block height of the window; omit for the current tip. Example: 3000000
to.title: To
